articles.summary: Contracts rarely stand alone. Master agreements spawn amendments, SOWs reference MSAs, and renewals extend original terms. This release introduces Document Relationships—a system that lets you map how your contracts connect, surface composite values across linked documents, and see the full picture of any deal at a glance. We’ve also brought AI-powered contract editing directly into the Word Add-in, so you can draft and revise without leaving your document.
articles.title: 🚀 Product Update: Document Relationships and AI Contract Editing
